conviction_note: Evidence on this print points both ways and nothing decides it. The crowded short (28.7% of shares outstanding at 15 Oct) and the name's history of rallying on prints (6 of 8 up) offset a weak US COVID market, the risk of a first 2027 framework that excludes Sanofi items, the end of the activist bid story and a 7.3-point put skew. abs_move is set at the 10.8% event-implied move, nudged up to 11 because a 2027 framework is likely. p_up is 51, close to a non-result. impact_sum (+0.80) and the scaled number (+0.22) have the same sign. The gap is the positioning finding, which I size on its own but cannot let move p_up much while the skew and the US vaccine data point down.
bar: DISPUTED. Earnings Whispers has Q3 revenue at ~$50.6M and EPS at -$0.33 (https://www.earningswhispers.com/article/NVAX/22450). Benzinga has $79.6M and -$0.21; Chartmill has $78.7M and -$0.22, revised down 22.5% in 3 months (https://www.chartmill.com/stock/quote/NVAX/estimates). The gap probably comes from whether unguided Sanofi supply sales and royalties are included. Company guidance (8-K, 2026-08-06, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001000694/000100069426000019/prfinal.htm) is an FY2026 adjusted total revenue framework of $235-275M that EXCLUDES Sanofi supply sales, royalties and milestones, with no quarterly guide. H1 GAAP revenue was $140M + $57M. Because the bar is not settled, every finding that rests on it is capped small.
positioning_check: Short interest (FINRA via Equibles, https://equibles.com/stocks/nvax/shortinterest): 47.35M shares at the 2026-10-15 settlement, up 1.30M, ~28.7% of 165M shares outstanding, 4.3 days to cover on elevated Oct volume. Sep 30: 46.0M, 8.1 days; Sep 15: 49.9M, 9.3 days. Equibles reported ~27.7% of float and 16.6 days in August. This is a crowded short. The baseline 25-delta skew is +7.28 vol points, so downside is paid, with put/call OI 0.52 and the ATM spread at 70% of mid (the implied move is indicative only). The stock ran from ~$10.6 at end-September to ~$12.8 on Oct 15, then fell to $10.37 (20d -7.6%) after Citi reiterated Sell ($8 PT, Oct 15) and Shah Capital's 13D/A (Oct 16). Analysts are 5 Buy / 2 Hold / 3 Sell, average PT $13.14 (MarketBeat, 2026-10-22).

findings.finding: The $125M milestone for the Sanofi Phase 3 flu-COVID combination trial start in Europe (fifth patient dosed) was earned in October 2026, per the 8-K of 2026-10-29. It falls in Q4, not in the reported Q3. Sanofi milestones are outside the $235-275M adjusted framework, so it lifts GAAP FY revenue and cash (cash was $724M at Jun 30) but not the guided number unless management restates the outlook on the call. Remaining milestones: $75M for the tech transfer (mid-2027) and $225M for a US combination launch.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The 2025 milestone-heavy quarters (Q2 2025 had the $175M BLA milestone) reacted +12.6% (2025-08-06). The milestone was public on Oct 29 and the stock did not hold any rally; it is still down 7.6% over 20 days.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: it was disclosed a week ago. What is not priced is whether management folds it into an updated FY2026 GAAP revenue/cash outlook or a lower 2027 cash burn on the call. If the market had credited it, the stock would have regained the $11-12 range it held before Oct 16. It has not.
findings.independence: ContractPharma coverage of the same event (https://www.contractpharma.com/breaking-news/sanofi-launches-phase-iii-flu-covid-vaccine-trial-in-europe-earning-novavax-125m/). It rests on the same company document, so it counts once.

findings.finding: The US COVID vaccine market this season looks weak. Pfizer's Q3 2026 release (Nov 3) shows US Comirnaty sales of $562M, down 35% from $870M, on 'narrower vaccine recommendations' and lower utilization. The FDA's August 2026 label limits the shot to 65+ and high-risk 5-64. An AJMC commentary of Oct 1 says there is still no ACIP recommendation for 2026-27. Sanofi's Q3 (Oct 30) combined Influenza/COVID-19 line was EUR1,256M, -18.8% CER, attributed to phasing into Q4. That is the volume base for Novavax's royalties (high teens to low twenties % of Sanofi net sales) and Sanofi supply sales. Sanofi's push partly offsets it: contracts with all major US retailers, DTC advertising, and launches in the UK, Germany and Canada. Net, a modest negative for Q3 royalties/supply and for the season tone on the call.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 2025 (2025-11-06) came with weak COVID sales, a profitability target pushed to 2028 and a 2026 framework far below consensus ($185-205M vs ~$450M), and the stock fell only 1.3%. Weak-season news has not been paid hard on prints.
findings.why_not_priced: Pfizer's number arrived the day before the window opens and is a peer series, not Novavax's own. Sanofi does not break out Nuvaxovid. The sell-side Q3 range ($50.6M vs ~$79M) shows nobody has a settled view of Sanofi-linked revenue. Because Sanofi items are outside the guide, the effect falls on unguided lines.
findings.independence: Sanofi Q3 2026 6-K (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001121404/000112140426000009/pressreleaseq32026english.htm, 2026-10-30): Influenza/COVID -18.8%, US -13.4%. AJMC on the missing ACIP recommendation (https://www.ajmc.com/view/who-recommends-covid-19-vaccines-without-acip-goad-pharmd). These are proxies; Novavax has not confirmed any season data.

findings.finding: This print will probably carry the first 2027 revenue framework. Precedent: the Q3 2025 release gave the first 2026 framework, $185-205M against ~$450M consensus (Reuters, 2025-11-06). The framework excludes Sanofi supply, royalties and milestones, while the 2026 base included one-time items (the $30M Pfizer upfront and ~$35M of amortization of the $500M Sanofi upfront over the transition). So an adjusted 2027 framework could print below the ~$258M 2027 revenue consensus (Simply Wall St, 9 analysts, updated June 2026), which likely includes Sanofi items.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: First-guide prints: 2025-11-06 gave a 2026 framework far below consensus and the stock fell 1.3%. 2026-02-26 (FY results / framework) rose 17.4%. 2026-08-06 raised the framework by $5M and the stock rose 0.5%.
findings.why_not_priced: The 2027 consensus is stale (June) and inconsistent across sources. Whether a framework comes on this date is an inference from last year's cadence, not a company statement. A wide range on the 2027 framework is the main reason abs_move stays at the implied move.
findings.independence: Q2 2026 8-K framework components (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001000694/000100069426000019/prfinal.htm) show the one-time items in the 2026 base. Simply Wall St 2027 consensus: https://simplywall.st/stocks/de/pharmaceuticals-biotech/fra-nvv1/novavax-shares/future.

findings.finding: Shah Capital, the activist (~6.4% holder) that publicly urged a sale of Novavax in Oct-Nov 2025, filed a 13D/A on 2026-10-16. It says it no longer holds 'with a purpose of influencing control', will move to 13G, and is restructuring into a family office. Shah Capital Fund LLC sold 2.87M shares at an average $11.35 as of Oct 5. This removes the takeover narrative, and the remaining 10.5M shares are a possible overhang.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The stock fell ~10.4% to $11.49 on 2026-10-16, the filing date (also the day after Citi's Sell reiteration). Shah's Oct 2025 sale call moved the stock only -1.3%.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced on Oct 16. What is left is that retail 'buyout' hopes (Asianet/Newsable, Aug 2026) lost their public sponsor, and a question on the call about M&A or the shareholder base could land harder without him.
findings.independence: The goldesel.de report of the Oct 16 drop (https://goldesel.de/aktien/news/novavax-aktie-kurs-fallt-um-104-prozent-auf-1149-us-dollar) gives the price move but not the cause. Otherwise none.

findings.finding: The short is crowded. 47.35M shares were short at the 2026-10-15 FINRA settlement (+1.30M, ~28.7% of 165M shares outstanding, 4.3 days to cover on Oct volume; 8-9 days in September). The name's last eight bmo prints rose 6 times, with +15.6% (May 2026), +17.4% (Feb 2026), +12.6% and +11.9% (2025). Any positive surprise (milestone flow into the outlook, a new Matrix-M deal, a better Sanofi season) meets short covering.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Baseline history: 6 of 8 prints up, median |move| 9.27%. The two downside prints were small (-1.3%, -3.55%), and the upside ones were 12-17%. That asymmetry is consistent with a heavily shorted name.
findings.why_not_priced: The +7.3 put skew and the 20-day decline show the option market is leaning down, which is against the squeeze. If the squeeze were priced, call-side vol would be bid and the skew would be flat or negative.
findings.independence: Earlier aggregator data put 45.7M short at 27.7% of float in August (Equibles via search). The history of outsized up-moves comes from the sealed baseline, which is independent of the short data.

findings.finding: Novavax has beaten revenue consensus in 8 of its last 8 quarters, by an average +57% (Chartmill). In Q2 2026 it reported $56.7M against ~$52.5M and EPS of -$0.32 against -$0.38, with a lower GAAP opex guide ($370-410M). Against the low $50.6M bar, a headline beat is likely. Against the ~$78M bars it is not clear. Sanofi supply sales for the 2026-27 season (unguided, $14M in Q3 2025) decide which.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The Q2 2026 beat-and-raise bought +0.5% (2026-08-06). The Q1 2026 beat bought +15.6% (2026-05-06). The reaction to beats is inconsistent.
findings.why_not_priced: The bar itself is disputed by ~$28M across sources, so 'beat' will be read differently by different desks. The size is capped small because the bar cannot be sourced to two agreeing estimates.
findings.independence: Q2 beat figures are from MarketBeat (https://www.marketbeat.com/instant-alerts/price-novavax-nasdaq-nvax-stock-falls-129-time-to-sell-2026-10-22/) and the 8-K of 2026-08-06.

outside_window.finding: $75M Sanofi milestone on completing the Nuvaxovid manufacturing tech transfer, expected mid-2027.
The 2026-10-30 FINRA short-interest settlement is published 2026-11-10, after the window. Equibles' model estimates ~45.1M shares, -4.7%.

baseline_tension: The put skew (+7.3) and the -7.6% 20-day run-up both lean down. The US vaccine data and the end of the activist bid agree with them. The crowded short and the name's 6-of-8 up history cut against them, so the net is close to zero and only slightly positive.
lessons_applied: Rule 6 (bar disputed: $50.6M vs ~$78M): capped the beat-history finding from +0.5 to +0.3, cut print_vs_bar_pct from +10 to +5, and moved p_up from 52 to 51.
Rule 1 (the Q2 beat-and-raise bought only +0.5%): kept the reported-quarter beat finding small.

Rule 7 (crowded short at 28.7%): shrank the negatives. The COVID season went from -1.0 to -0.8, the 2027 framework from -0.5 to -0.4, and Shah from -0.3 to -0.2. The positioning finding stays at +1.5.
Rule 2 (one-off): the $125M milestone is a Q4 item outside the adjusted framework, so it went from +0.5 to +0.4, filed under guidance only for its possible path into a restated outlook.
Rule 5 (proxy): the Pfizer/Sanofi transmission stays filed small, with independence marked as proxy.
